dedupe_keys.name: iaea nuclear data services evaluated and experimental nuclear reaction structure and decay data endf exfor ensdf

description: The IAEA Nuclear Data Section portal provides fundamental nuclear and atomic data for nuclear science and applications, including the cross sections and decay data that reactor physics codes take as input. The front page read on the day of cataloguing links ENDF evaluated nuclear reaction libraries, the EXFOR experimental nuclear reaction database, the LiveChart interactive chart of nuclides, a medical radioisotope portal, RIPL reference input parameters and a fusion data portal, plus nuclear structure and decay data such as ENSDF and the actinide decay data library, application libraries such as FENDL and IRDFF, and processing software including PREPRO, EMPIRE, TALYS and ENDF checking codes, with a GitHub organisation. Coverage is global evaluated and measured data, not facilities. Access is free on the web; the portal pages read state no single licence, and the IAEA overview page was behind a bot check. Caveats: these are physics libraries that feed simulation codes, not infrastructure asset data, and correct use needs processing into code formats. Simulation uses are neutron transport, depletion and shielding calculations for reactor design, safety analysis and reactor digital twins. Related records: model-openmc and platform-moose-multiphysics-framework are reactor codes that use such libraries.
